ev.q: Approximately three in 10 (29.7%) nursing home residents received the 2024–2025 COVID-19 vaccine, with coverage ranging from 19.8% in HHS Region 6 to 38.6% in HHS Region 8.
Estimates of coverage (percentage of residents vaccinated) with COVID-19, influenza, and RSV vaccines, and 95% CIs were estimated using Poisson regression models.
COVID-19 vaccination coverage was highest in the least socially vulnerable counties (33.6%) and in small facilities (34.7%) and lowest in large facilities (28.0%).
Data reported from CMS-certified nursing homes for the week of November 10, 2024, were used for analysis.
Nursing homes electronically report the number of residents who occupied a bed at the facility
